verdict.rationale: The only scaling evidence says users can scale CPU/RAM or add replicas with load balancing. That describes manual vertical scaling and replica provisioning, not load-based autoscaling that adds capacity automatically during traffic bursts. Load balancing across replicas is an adjacent feature, and no evidence shows scaling triggered by traffic or load metrics.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can rely on load-based autoscaling to absorb large traffic bursts automatically

citations.quote: Scale CPU and RAM or add replicas with load balancing.
